categories.main_business_segments: Dongguan Eontec Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, design, production, and sales of new materials including liquid metal, magnesium alloy, aluminum alloy, medical materials, and polymer materials. Its products serve industries such as new energy vehicles, consumer electronics, medical devices, 5G communications, and intelligent manufacturing. The company operates through segments focused on automotive parts, liquid metal products, consumer electronics structural components, organic silicone, industrial parts, and precision molds.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies such as large-scale vacuum die casting for magnesium-aluminum alloys, precision mold design, CNC machining, surface treatment, and integrated production lines. It holds proprietary patents in liquid metal (amorphous alloy) composition, melting, precision molding, and vacuum forming equipment. The firm also pioneers in bio-degradable medical magnesium alloys with clinical trial-backed products. It employs smart manufacturing systems (MES 4.0) for digital and intelligent production management.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading domestic and international new energy vehicle manufacturers like Tesla, BYD, Huawei, and major automotive parts suppliers such as Bosch and ZF. The company also serves consumer electronics brands including Lenovo, HP, and GoPro, as well as medical device companies and 5G communication equipment providers like Ericsson and Huawei. Its markets span automotive, consumer electronics, medical devices, 5G infrastructure, and sports equipment sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters and major production facilities in Dongguan and subsidiaries in cities like Zhuzhou, Shenzhen, and Chaohu. It has overseas operations including a wholly-owned Hong Kong subsidiary. Its products are sold domestically and exported internationally, with export revenue accounting for about one-third of total sales.
categories.supply_chain_position: Dongguan Eontec operates mainly in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on the development and manufacturing of advanced materials and precision components. It integrates upstream R&D and raw material processing with downstream assembly and delivery of finished parts to OEMs and system integrators in automotive and electronics industries.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D in liquid metal materials, magnesium-aluminum alloy lightweighting for new energy vehicles, and bio-degradable medical magnesium implants. It invests heavily in developing integrated die casting technologies, high-strength and high-thermal-conductivity alloys, and advanced manufacturing equipment. Strategic initiatives include expanding clinical trials for medical magnesium products, enhancing digital manufacturing capabilities, and broadening applications of liquid metal in consumer electronics and automotive sectors.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of precision die-cast components, liquid metal products, and medical implants. The company operates on an order-driven production model, providing customized product development, mold design, manufacturing, and after-sales services. It also receives government subsidies and grants related to R&D and industrial innovation.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Dongguan Eontec is positioned as a leading domestic new materials company with strong core technologies and a comprehensive industrial chain. It is among the earliest global adopters of large-scale magnesium-aluminum alloy die casting equipment and the sole global supplier of liquid metal automotive parts to Tesla. The company holds a competitive edge in bio-degradable medical magnesium alloys and liquid metal applications, maintaining a strong market presence against increasing competition in new energy vehicle components and consumer electronics materials.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 1.65 billion, a slight decline of 3.19% year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders dropping by 70.49% to about RMB 1 million due to pricing pressures, increased safety investments, and asset disposals. Despite profit decline, operating cash flow remained stable. The company has total assets around RMB 2.74 billion and equity of about RMB 1.09 billion, with ongoing investments in R&D and production capacity expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Dongguan Eontec emphasizes its unique integration of proprietary new material technologies, advanced manufacturing processes, and a full industrial chain to deliver high-precision, lightweight, and high-performance components. Its liquid metal products offer superior strength, elasticity, and environmental benefits, while its bio-degradable magnesium implants reduce patient burden by eliminating secondary surgeries. The company provides one-stop solutions from design to after-sales, ensuring high quality and customization to meet diverse customer needs in cutting-edge industries.
